name: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Attachments Tamper
description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies attachments (See reference for more information)
author: GAI_CTI
query: registry.path:*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Attachments\\* AND ((registry.path:*\\HideZoneInfoOnProperties AND winlog.event_data.Details:DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)) OR (registry.path:*\\SaveZoneInformation AND winlog.event_data.Details:DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)) OR (registry.path:*\\ScanWithAntiVirus AND winlog.event_data.Details:DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)))
